title: World Athletics Label Road Races results — Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris, 13 April 2025
claims: World Athletics records the Paris marathon in Paris (FRA) on 13 April 2025 under event ID 7221864.
Men's winner: Benard BIWOTT (KEN) 2:05:25; men's runner-up Ibrahim Hassan (DJI) 2:06:13.
Women's winner: Bedatu HIRPA (ETH) 2:20:45; runner-up Dera DIDA (ETH) 2:20:49; third Angela TANUI (KEN) 2:21:07.
World Athletics reports the 2025 event as a World Athletics Elite Label road race.
